projects.title: ANIMEXA – AI-Powered Animal Care Platform
projects.description: ANIMEXA is an AI-powered full-stack animal care and welfare management platform that integrates pet registration, veterinary appointments, medical records, vaccination tracking, pet shopping, adoption, animal rescue, grooming, boarding, and pet travel services. It also features Nexa AI, an intelligent chatbot designed to assist pet owners with general pet care guidance and service recommendations.
